semantic_reason: The PR fixes a reported crash: Styler raised Protocol.UndefinedError (Enumerable not implemented for {:unquote, ...} tuple) at lib/style/single_node.ex:144 when encountering non-arrowed case statements like `case x, do: unquote(clauses)`. The patch changes existing behavior by adding an `is_list(arrows)` guard to `r_align_matches` and a fallback clause that returns the node unchanged, directly correcting the failing stacktrace described in issue #69; CHANGELOG labels it under 'Fixes'.
